name: Britania Public Company Limited
summary: Britania Public Company Limited engages in property development business in Thailand. It develops detached and semidetached houses, townhouses, and other properties under the Belgravia, Grand Britania, Britania, Balco, Balco Lagoon, and Brighton brand names. The company was formerly known as Origin House Company Limited. Britania Public Company Limited was founded in 2016 and is based in Bangkok, Thailand. Britania Public Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Origin Property Public Company Limited.
